rows.label: tlk70000020_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I spend a lot of time
watching people from here.

rows.label: tlk70000020_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Precisely because we've suffered a
great disaster, people's bonds are
growing stronger.

rows.label: tlk70000020_02_msg0003
rows.name:
A disaster may be just that, or it may
be something much more - a catalyst
for change. It all depends on us.

rows.label: tlk70000020_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Events themselves are never purely
good or evil. What matters is the
heart with which people receive them.
